variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
While the rest of Brackenford frets over Red Corwin, there's a smaller job which I need done.

Tobin, my hired man, chased the Urchins who broke into the mill last night and took the Amulet of Plenty.

Those Urchins have burrowed into the old barrow east of the ford. Tobin went in after them. He hasn't come out.

Will you bring the Amulet back to me and find out what became of Tobin?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
You found the Amulet of Plenty! Wonderful!

My worst fears for Tobin, however, have come to pass. I'll miss the old goat, but we have no time for weeping. Reeve Halvard needs help with Red Corwin and has been asking for you.

Take this, with my thanks!

journal.text: Recover the Amulet of Plenty the Urchins stole from Wenna's mill.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Hardly anybody comes up to this gate these days.

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: Out of my forge, stranger! I don't sell blades to BANDITS!

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: I wonder who cuts Red Corwin's hair?

variants.specifics: Dolgar: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Brunna
offer.text:
Where have you been all this time!? Something terrible has happened!

Monstrous leeches and shrieking bats from the Deep have swarmed the mushroom farms. Brave pickers have perished in the service of Dolgar's dinner tables!

Please, I implore you! Drive the vermin from the farms, save my pickers and I'll pay you generously.

This key opens the shed where my first picker is hiding. She knows where the rest of them are.

I also have a spell book that may come in handy.

completion.speaker: Brunna
completion.text:
You're a hero through and through! I can't thank you enough.

While you were down in the farms, chasing off those leeches, Haskel stopped in, asking after you. He'll meet you at the Great Lift -- west of here.

But first, please take this gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Kill or charm every beast in the mushroom farms. Save the 4 pickers trapped there.

guard.speaker: Durm
guard.text:
I'd go see Foreman Brask first...
unless you'd like to feel his boot.

shop.speaker: Ozwick
shop.text: Welcome, Wanderer! I hope you'll bring me a few bat wings from the Deep. I wouldn't mind grinding some into potions myself!

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: Topsider! Bah! I've heard all about how your lot cheat us miners! Leave me be!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Those Urchins just made off with my uncle's lucky amulet! If it isn't found, he'll be ruined. He's coming home from market tonight!

Oh please, help me, kind stranger! I think the Urchins that grabbed it ran to the net sheds.

Will you... could you find it for me?

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! Please take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Retrieve Nella's amulet from the Urchins at the net sheds.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: What's this? The Causeway gate is shut by order! You'd better go see Mayor Dobbet if you mean to cross. The Ogres are out there.

shop.speaker: Fennick
shop.text: Mogrut's Ogres have pulled up the north walkway.

townsfolk1.speaker: Moggs
townsfolk1.text: That does it! First the birds go quiet then the Ogres come. Run for the boats!

townsfolk2.speaker: Dabb
townsfolk2.text: We've held the walkways! Now we must chase the Ogres out of the whole Gloamfen!

variants.specifics: Korlen: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? That Ogre beat both of my bell boys black and blue. There's no time to fetch the guard. Hurry, you must catch him before the clapper of the great bell is gone for good.

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: The clapper is saved! Commander Dorvik will need it to ring the alarm on the walls. Here, take my Bow and bring the clapper to him.

journal.text: Recover the bell's clapper stolen by the Ogre thief.

guard.speaker: Fisk
guard.text: Hey, you could do with a proper helmet.

shop.speaker: Tobb
shop.text: Pssst! Hey! You there! Want a helmet? Cheapest in Korlen and they're off real Ogre heads!

townsfolk1.speaker: Gisla
townsfolk1.text: I sense a dark storm gathering over Korlen! Can anyone save us now?

townsfolk2.speaker: Marga
townsfolk2.text: My, my! You're a sight better looking than the lads in the garrison! Come and see me once you've finished with the Ogres.

variants.specifics: Ondel: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ishmar
offer.text:
Miserable little thieves! The Imps only flew down from the hills last month and they are already a terrible nuisance!

I am Ishmar the Conjurer. I am missing my Rain Staff. I fear the Imps have carried it off to their nest on Gull Rock.

If you could find it and return it to me, I would take you along in my boat to Tavarin. Will you do this for me?

completion.speaker: Ishmar
completion.text:
My Rain Staff! Those little devils must have fought over it.

You have shown the Imps who is master here. Perhaps you might be of further use to me. Hmmm... Very well.

Come down to my boathouse with me. Whenever you wish, just climb into the boat and I will row us across to Tavarin. There is a great deal to be done once we land.

journal.text: Retrieve Ishmar's Rain Staff from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: Only fishermen go down to the boats!

shop.speaker: Moll
shop.text: Wanna buy a potion? They're boiled up from the slimiest weeds at the bottom of Lake Dorrow.

townsfolk1.speaker: Ardle
townsfolk1.text: Welcome to the Net Hall. Mayor Wendrel's rooms are at the back.

townsfolk2.speaker: Wilda
townsfolk2.text: How can a few fishermen fight off the dead? It's hopeless! Where can we go?

variants.specifics: Ostrel: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Umbrik
offer.text:
These filthy bats are a curse on my house! My students tried to smoke them out, but back they come every night! You are my last hope of getting the vermin out!

The bats are up in my reading room, there, at the top of the stairs. Please, watch yourself.

completion.speaker: Umbrik
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my heartfelt thanks! You have earned the friendship of the College. The porters will be told that you may enter the Archive whenever you like.

Here is some gold for your pains. I must insist.

journal.text: Drive the bats out of Archivist Umbrik's reading room.

shop.speaker: Bolgar
shop.text:
A stranger, eh? Most folks here won't trust an outsider, but they've never been past the town gate and I've been clear to the coast! What do they know about anything!? Eh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're always welcome under my roof, friend.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townswoman
townsfolk1.text: You're awful skinny for a monster-slayer. Hee, hee, hee...!

townsfolk2.speaker: Old Man
townsfolk2.text: No, we must not sleep while Malgrith's Ghosts walk the hills!

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Vardis
offer.text:
Ebbet has been forging a Silver Horn for the fort for a long while. It ought to have been done and carried up the pass by now.

Take the goat path down to Ebbet's hut on the west slope and bring back the Horn. Will you go for me?

completion.speaker: Vardis
completion.text:
You've brought back the Silver Horn! Wonderful!

Poor Ebbet, however, is gone, as I feared he would be. I will grieve for him, but sadly the Undead leave us no time for it. Take this Ankh for your trouble, and Warden Ostrag has asked to see you.

Good luck, Wanderer!

journal.text: Recover the Silver Horn which Ebbet has made.

guard.speaker: Haddo
guard.text: You're mighty thin for these mountains.

townsfolk1.speaker: Mirta
townsfolk1.text: Hey who let the fire go out?

townsfolk2.speaker: Dolgo
townsfolk2.text: Greetings! My name is Dolgo. I hunt and trap the mountain bears to keep the high road safe for traders.

variants.specifics: Vurn: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Grenna
offer.text:
Oh please, kind sir, help me! The Rats have overrun my coal cellar and my poor pig, Gubbin, is shut in down there with them!

Get rid of them and fetch him out and I'll owe you my life!

completion.speaker: Grenna
completion.text:
Oh, thank heavens, you've got him! How will I ever pay you back for such courage?!

What's that, now? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if that's your price, here, accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Gubbin the Pig from a Rat-infested cellar in Vurn.

shop.speaker: Zelphine
shop.text: Adventurers always get a fair price at my shop. What would you like to see?

townsfolk1.speaker: Pibble
townsfolk1.text: So you've come to join the smiths! Welcome to the guild! As makers of the town's steel, we carry a heavy load. I trust you'll do us proud at the anvil.

townsfolk2.speaker: Lissa
townsfolk2.text: The traders of Tarvel are a greedy and crooked pack of swindlers! Worst of all is that fat cheat, Grisold!

variants.specifics: Varrow: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Olla
offer.text:
Hello, brave Adventurer! Oh, please help me, a dreadful fever has struck my son!

Not long ago, a pack of Urchins broke into the mill. One of the little beasts bit my boy, and now he burns with fever! I could heal him with my healing amulet, but they ran off with it to their caves east of the mill. I dare not leave his bedside, or he may get worse!

Will you get my amulet back from those thieves? I will pay a worthy reward for its safe return.

completion.speaker: Olla
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! I can't ever repay you enough for this kindness... But please, accept this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Recover Widow Olla's healing amulet from the Urchin caves.

guard.speaker: Brannoc
guard.text: Greetings! My name is Brannoc. I guard this gate so nobody wanders up the north road and gets robbed blind.

shop.speaker: Dorrit
shop.text: Hello traveler. You know there's not one bed left, what with the north road shut.

townsfolk1.speaker: Hosk
townsfolk1.text: Somebody must deal with those Urchins! Smoke out their caves and bring back what they stole.

townsfolk2.speaker: Quilp
townsfolk2.text: Don't give up hope yet, friend, the wolves will run from our torches!

variants.specifics: Tolm: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Brunn
offer.text:
Truth be told, my farm's been doing rather poorly of late. Ten nights back, Bears broke into the sty and dragged off my pigs.

I don't suppose I'll ever get my pigs back, but I'd like nothing better than to see those Bears hunted down.

I'll gladly pay whoever puts an end to them.

completion.speaker: Brunn
completion.text:
So those Bears are finished! Good work, lad! My pigs can rest easy knowing those brutes won't be shoving their big hairy snouts in my sty!

And here's what I promised... 90 gold pieces! You're welcome at my farm anytime!

journal.text: Hunt down the Bears that have been stealing Brunn's pigs.

guard.speaker: Dorrik
guard.text: Mayor Corbel has shut the east gate until somebody chases the Ogres out of the bean fields. Somebody ought to go and get Zelna. She usually just puts the Ogres to sleep instead of fighting them.

shop.speaker: Kettick
shop.text: Ogres trampled the barley. Need a sword?

townsfolk1.speaker: Pella
townsfolk1.text: Yaaaaagh! Get it out of my apron!

townsfolk2.speaker: Hobb
townsfolk2.text: Is it true what folks say about Ogres?
